search_text: published ZDI-14-068 ZDI-CAN-1898 SolarWinds Firewall Security Manager FSMWebService Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2014-04-08 7.8 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:C/I:N/A:N ['SolarWinds'] ['Firewall Security Manager'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of SolarWinds Firewall Security Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the FSMWebService service. The issue lies within the DownloadFileServlet servlet which fails to prevent directory traversal within all parameters.
